summary_en: Circular letter of the Congregation for the Sacraments and Divine Worship (sent 12 June 1979) to the presidents of episcopal conferences and national liturgical commissions: by the Apostolic Letter « Rutilans agmen » of 8 May 1979 John Paul II raised the celebration of St Stanislaus, bishop and martyr, in the General Roman Calendar from optional memorial to obligatory memorial, effective from the liturgical year 1979-1980; the date (11 April) and the texts of Missal and Liturgy of the Hours are unchanged, and where particular law keeps him on another day or grade that remains in force. The extract of the Apostolic Letter is printed in Notitiae 154, p. 235.

CD 660/79, Romae, die 29 maii 1979 — ... in qua statuitur celebrationem Sancti Stanislai Calendario Romano generali posthac inscribendam esse gradu memoriae obligatoriae, loco memoriae « ad libitum », sicut nunc habetur.
